name: TimePlanning

custom.system_prompt: You are generating calendar management conversations.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where a person is trying to coordinate their schedule for medical appointments with help from a digital assistant.

setting.mood: Concerned but determined to find timely appointments
setting.background: User needs to schedule multiple medical appointments while minimizing impact on work schedule
setting.conversation_style: Supportive and focused on health priorities while acknowledging professional obligations

scenario_template.note: User discusses the medical appointments needed and initial constraints
User realizes the scheduling complexity with multiple appointments and preparation requirements
User explicitly addresses assistant as Sigma on first interaction
Assistant provides scheduling suggestions considering medical requirements and recovery periods
User discusses the proposed medical schedule and how it affects work commitments
Assistant helps create a final schedule with appropriate spacing between appointments

scenario_template.mood: Relieved to have a manageable schedule
scenario_template.note: User expresses confidence in the medical scheduling plan

variations.context: Booking a follow-up around school pickup

setting.background: The only slots offered clash with the school run.

scenario_template.topic: Three slots offered, all in the pickup window
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Whether anyone else can collect the children
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Taking a slot that just about works with a rush
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He says half two would be tight but possible, weighing it up.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma what is in his calendar next Wednesday afternoon.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Rearranging an appointment after a cancellation call

setting.background: The surgery cancelled and offered a slot six weeks out.

scenario_template.topic: The appointment he waited five weeks for is cancelled
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: The replacement offered is six weeks away
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Asking to go on the cancellation list instead
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: He mutters that six weeks is no use at all.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: He asks Sigma to remind him to ring the surgery each morning.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.
